refs.purpose: Inherit open entries rather than re-deriving them, close the ones this brief's input, output, and label decisions settle, and append interface obligations the narrative never settles — an output the source names but never specifies, a parameter stated only qualitatively, a collection shape the prose doesn't determine.
refs.verification: Promote after a worked run shows entries this Mold appends or resolves are consumed downstream without re-derivation.

refs.purpose: Preserve the authority boundary between reviewed intent, optional source evidence, and downstream Galaxy design decisions.
refs.verification: Confirm a worked run does not broaden brief scope from richer source evidence and leaves the brief unchanged.

refs.purpose: Validate the required Workflow Brief before treating it as the implementation contract.

produces.description: Reviewable Markdown brief: Galaxy workflow inputs, outputs, labels, collection shapes, checkpoint outputs, Workflow Brief provenance, supporting-evidence citations, confidence, and open questions.
Carried obligations ledger re-emitted by this step: entries it appended or closed updated, every other entry passed through with its provenance intact.

consumes.description: Expert-reviewed implementation contract. Its objective, scope, requirements, acceptance criteria, and exclusions govern every interface decision.
Optional narrative source evidence; it may clarify the selected scope but cannot broaden or override the brief.
Optional structured Nextflow source evidence; process, channel, parameter, and test facts are evidence rather than assumed Galaxy design.
Carried workflow-run knowledge [[open-requirements-ledger]]. Absent on the first design Mold of a run; initialize an empty ledger.
